**The pitch**

What do you want added or changed, in one or two sentences?

**Why it fits RIFTBOUND**

How does it serve the dark-fantasy roguelike loop (descend, fight, break
the echoes)? Reference Hades/Hades 2 systems by name if that is the
inspiration.

**Scope guess**

- [ ] Game logic only (`src/game/`)
- [ ] UI only (`src/components/game/`)
- [ ] Both sides of the bus (needs a new event type in `src/game/types.ts`)
- [ ] New assets (pipeline rerun required)
- [ ] Balance-sensitive (numbers in `src/game/config.ts`)

**Notes**

Anything else - prior art, edge cases, tuning ideas.
